title: Senior Interior Designer | Workplace Interiors
description:
Title:

Senior Interior Designer | Workplace Interiors

Client:

Our client is a full-service architecture and interior design firm specializing in innovative workplace environments for media, technology, financial, and professional services clients. With a collaborative and design-driven studio culture, the firm delivers sophisticated commercial interiors for leading corporate organizations.

Description:

Our client is seeking a Senior Interior Designer with 5+ years of experience in commercial workplace interiors to join their New York team. This position is focused on interior architecture and workplace design, requiring a strong technical and design background in built commercial interior projects.

The ideal candidate will have experience leading projects from programming through construction administration, developing workplace strategies, and producing high-quality construction documentation for sophisticated office environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead commercial workplace interior design projects from programming through construction administration
  • Develop space plans, test fits, and design concepts for workplace environments
  • Guide design direction and evaluate solutions based on client goals and project requirements
  • Select and specify materials, finishes, furniture, and interior systems
  • Produce and oversee construction documentation including plans, elevations, and detailed drawings
  • Coordinate with architects, consultants, and project teams throughout all project phases
  • Support strategic project execution while maintaining high standards of design and technical excellence
  • Participate in workplace strategy discussions and research emerging industry trends

Requirements:

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in commercial interior design or interior architecture, preferably workplace interiors
  • Strong experience producing construction documents and detailing
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD required
  • Proficiency in Revit required
  • Experience with Revit-based 3D modeling and rendering workflows such as Enscape or similar platforms
  • Experience working on built commercial interior projects, not solely conceptual design work
  • Strong hand sketching and conceptual visualization abilities
  • Knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and InDesign
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and project coordination skills
  • Strong understanding of workplace planning and commercial interior detailing

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience developing workplace strategies for corporate clients
  • Familiarity with hybrid workplace planning, utilization trends, and activity-based work environments
  • Interest in researching emerging workplace trends and best practices
  • LEED AP and/or WELL AP accreditation preferred

title: Senior-level QA QC Field Manager | High-rise Institutional buildings (BK facility)
description:
Job Title:
Senior-level QA QC Field Manager | High-rise Institutional buildings (BK facility)

Client:
Our client is an international firm providing professional and technical support services to public and private sector clients. Their expertise includes government and institutional facilities, bridge and highway construction, transportation design and commercial and residential building facilities construction/maintenance. They use their extensive knowledge to restore and replace aging infrastructure across cities, countries, and continents. Recent projects include a new subway line in New York City, the world's largest green-field port development in Qatar, a 24-kilometer sea crossing in Malaysia and the expansion of LA International Airport. Over five-thousand Architects and 75,000 Engineers work for this A/E firm around the world.

Job Description:
Immediate need for a QA QC Field Manager who will be assigned full-time to the project site (Mon-Fri). The role requires strong communication skills, teamwork, and the ability to work independently. This role supports Program Management by reviewing the builder’s QC processes and implementing an owner spot-check program to verify compliance. The role is limited to observation, documentation, and reporting. It doesn’t direct construction means and methods.

Responsibilities:
  • Review Design Builder QA QC plans, inspections, and procedures for contract compliance.
  • Review QC reports and identify trends.
  • Implement Owner QA QC spot check program to verify field compliance.
  • Perform field verifications.
  • Maintain compliance tracker linking various requirements.
  • Issue field observations with photos and references.
  • Conduct pre-inspection walk-throughs.
  • Coordinate site visits to consolidate findings for follow-ups.
  • Provide quality reporting, including risks and deviations.
Qualifications:
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction or a relevant field of study.
  • Demonstrated ability to issue and close quality observations/non-conformances required.
  • Previous experience working with NYC agencies (MTA, DDC, SCA, PANYNJ...)
  • NICET certification desired.
  • ACI certifications are desired.
  • Previous experience working with high-rise construction and ground-up construction.
  • Strong computer skills and strong verbal and written skills in a client-facing capacity.
  • Ability to maintain discretion and confidentiality.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Architecture; Engineering, Construction, or related field.

title: Senior Interior Designer | Luxury Residential
description:
Title:
Senior Interior Designer | Luxury Residential

Client:
Our client is a contemporary, high-end residential design boutique based in Brooklyn, NY. The firm delivers fully integrated architecture and interior design services, managing projects from initial concept through construction and furniture installation. Known for a refined, hands-on approach, the studio creates timeless, highly customized residences for a discerning luxury clientele.

Position Overview:
The firm is seeking a Senior Interior Designer to join the team on a permanent basis. This role is ideal for a seasoned designer with strong design leadership, technical expertise, and hands-on experience delivering luxury residential projects from concept through completion. The Senior Interior Designer will play a key role in overseeing projects, guiding design direction, and collaborating closely with clients, consultants, and vendors.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide creative leadership and contribute to overall design concepts and detailed design schemes

  • Source, specify, and coordinate high-end finishes, materials, and FF&E

  • Maintain strong relationships with showrooms, vendors, fabricators, and suppliers

  • Produce and oversee design and construction documentation, including furniture plans, layouts, elevations, custom millwork details, and bespoke furniture designs

  • Coordinate project pricing, budgets, and schedules in collaboration with the team

  • Serve as a point of contact for clients, participating in meetings and presentations as needed

  • Oversee construction, site visits, and installation to ensure design intent and quality are upheld

  • Support overall studio operations, project organization, and mentorship of junior staff as needed

Requirements:

  • Minimum 6–8+ years of post-graduate experience in high-end or luxury residential interior design

  • Degree in Interior Design or Architecture

  • Proven experience completing multiple luxury residential projects in the U.S. from concept through installation

  • Deep knowledge of luxury finishes, furniture, materials, and manufacturers

  • Strong conceptual design, design development, and detailing skills

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop required)
